issues.description: The method singFarmSongVerse is declared as private in the UML (problem statement) and the template Farm.java (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), but the solution implements it as protected and with a parameter (protected void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). This visibility/signature mismatch between problem/template and the provided solution may confuse students about the intended visibility and signature of the helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility and signature consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution method to private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) to match the UML/template, or update the UML and template to declare the method as protected and include the Animal parameter. Also ensure the template method signature includes the Animal parameter so students implement the verse helper with the intended parameter.
